The cardinality of a finite set $T$ is the number of elements in $T.$ 

Let's start by listing all the elements of $T:$

$$
{},\,x,\,y,\,{v,x,{w}},
$$

Note that ${v,x,{w}}$ and ${}$ count as single elements of $T.$

Since $T$ has $3$ elements, the cardinality is $|T|=4.$
